_schema_comment: Soft-gate attestation log. Append-only by any agent. Entry kinds: request | approved | rejected | no_objection (auto-clear past SLA). Fields per entry: kind, task_id, agent_id, summary, artifact_paths, expected_observable, observed_actual, ts, sla_hours. The 'no_objection' kind is appended by tools/gate_sla_check.py when a request's SLA expires without human input. See agent/autonomy.md §2.1 for the lifecycle.
